newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr,busy yen futures weaken on BCE.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr,busy yen futures weaken on BCE.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar following the U.S. unit's losses against major currencies, but the gap separating it from the central bank bid widened to 30 to 35 pips, dealers said.
"The gap widened as many dealers closed short dollar positions," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank. "In addition, the end-of-month currency buying is approaching."
The forint closed at 169.60/65 against the dollar, compared with its opening of 170.35/40.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, all yen and most dollar maturities finished lower.
The yen was the most traded currency future, accounting for 6,820 contracts, or one billion forints ($5.9 million), of total turnover of 14,487 contracts, or 2.38 billion forints.
The German mark remained steady, and the lira closed lower for one maturity.
Swiss franc, Ecu and sterling futures ended mixed.
